events.name: WorldConnectionSelectionChanged
events.emission: Emit only after successful durable selection of a changed connection/world; receipt.result is the resulting current context. Failed/no-change selection emits nothing.

events.name: ActiveWorldChanged
events.emission: Emit only after successful durable switch to a different world; receipt.result is the resulting current context. Preserve currentSession and clear out-of-world selection.

events.name: AffectedObjectNotificationRequired
events.runtimeTrigger: AnalyzeAffectedObjects → durable BLOCK_AND_NOTIFY decision, or direct declared decision call
events.emission: Emit only for successful policy decision BLOCK_AND_NOTIFY on nonselected affected objects; receipt.result carries the displayed immutable affected set/decision revision. NO_NOTIFICATION/CONTINUE/CANCEL do not emit this signal.

events.name: TransactionVerified
events.runtimeTrigger: ApplyRecoverableCommit → internal verified Readback + durable history
events.emission: Emit only after full matched readback and durable linked history, status VERIFIED. receipt.result is the final verified transaction receipt; pending/restore failure/history persist failure never emits.

events.name: HistoryPositionChanged
events.emission: Emit only after the whole linked Undo or Redo transaction is VERIFIED with durable movement of all linked heads; operation Undo/Redo is the finite signal discriminator/direction. receipt.result is that verified receipt. Conflict proposal, rollback/failure and unchanged heads emit nothing.

events.name: HistoryPositionChanged
events.emission: Emit only after the whole linked Undo or Redo transaction is VERIFIED with durable movement of all linked heads; operation Undo/Redo is the finite signal discriminator/direction. receipt.result is that verified receipt. Conflict proposal, rollback/failure and unchanged heads emit nothing.
